headline: Rome criteria reclassify most hospitalised COPD exacerbations, report says
dek: The American Journal of Managed Care reports that applying the Rome criteria changed the classification of most hospitalised COPD exacerbations.
body:
Applying the Rome criteria leads to the reclassification of most hospitalised exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), according to a report from The American Journal of Managed Care.

The item's headline is the only information available from the source. It does not give the study design, the patient numbers, the proportion of exacerbations reclassified, the categories involved or the authors. It also does not name the journal in which the underlying research appeared.

Further details will be added if the full report or the original study becomes available.
